verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
The Lord is my light and my salvation
In whom shall I fear? Whom shall I fear?
The Lord is my strength, the stronghold of my life
In whom shall I fear? Whom shall I fear?

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You said, “Seek My face”
Your face, O God, I seek

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
One thing I ask and I will seek
To dwell in the house of the Lord all my days
To gaze upon Your beauty, worship at Your feet
Oh, one thing I seek

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Holy fire, Abba Father
My Redeemer, my delight
Holy, holy, God Almighty
You’re the one thing that I desire

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Holy fire, Abba Father
My Redeemer, my delight
Holy, holy, God Almighty
Be the one thing that I desire
